contract: GET /api/search/covers returns {results} for a cover search. With provider custom-<id> it queries the stored provider at its url + /search with mediaType=book, query=title and author, and returns the matches' covers in match order with duplicates removed and coverless matches skipped. A missing title is 400; provider=all, best or an unknown value with an empty title answers results []; podcast=1 with an empty title answers results null; no token is 401.
exceptions: Unexecuted here: the built-in provider success paths (google, itunes, openlibrary, fantlab, audiobookcovers, audible) call fixed external hosts, so their result parsing and fuzzy fallback are not asserted by this packet; every deterministic offline path is asserted.

invariants.contract: GET /api/search/covers?provider=custom-<id>&title=Alpha&author=Ann answers 200 with a results array; the stored provider received one GET /search with mediaType=book, query=Alpha and author=Ann; the array holds the matches' cover values in match order, deduplicated, with a match that has no cover omitted.

GET /api/search/covers answers 401 without a token and 400 when title is absent (with and without podcast=1) or provider is repeated as an array. With title= (empty string) the all, best and an unknown provider answer 200 with results [], and podcast=1&title= answers 200 with results null, none of them contacting a provider.
